arxiv-2202-05475.title: Circular polarization of fast radio bursts in the curvature radiation scenario
arxiv-2202-05475.creator: H. Tong, H. G. Wang
arxiv-2202-05475.description: Abstract The curvature radiation is applied to the explain the circular polarization of FRBs. Significant circular polarization is reported in both apparently non-repeating and repeating FRBs. Curvature radiation can produce significant circular polarization at the wing of the radiation beam.

arxiv-2301-13557.title: On locating and neighbor-locating colorings of sparse graphs
arxiv-2301-13557.creator: Dipayan Chakraborty, Florent Foucaud, Soumen Nandi, Sagnik Sen, D K Supraja ( a ) (a) Université Clermont Auvergne, CNRS, Clermont Auvergne INP, Mines Saint-Étienne,LIMOS, 63000 Clermont-Ferrand, France ( b ) (b) Netaji Subhas Open University, India ( c ) (c) Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad,
arxiv-2301-13557.description: Abstract A proper k k -coloring of a graph G G is a neighbor-locating k k -coloring if for each pair of vertices in the same color class, the two sets of colors found in their respective neighborhoods are different.

arxiv-2404-01534.title: Strange Sounds
arxiv-2404-01534.creator: D. V. Khveshchenko
arxiv-2404-01534.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by D. V. Khveshchenko. This note addresses the effects of long-ranged and/or retarded interactions on the bosonic collective modes in the so-called ’strange metals’. Recently, there have been conflicting reports on the very existence of such stable collective excitations and their properties. Extending a number of approaches that were previously used in the analyses of the standard Fermi liquid one finds evidence for, both, conventional and novel behaviors of the non-Fermi-liquid counterparts of the zero-, shear-, and other ’sounds’.

arxiv-2407-14838.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation Integrated Large Language Models in Smart Contract Vulnerability Detection
arxiv-2407-14838.creator: Jeffy Yu
arxiv-2407-14838.description: Abstract \footertext 1 1. Introduction The rapid expansion of blockchain technology and decentralized finance (DeFi) has transformed the financial landscape, offering novel opportunities for peer-to-peer transactions and automated financial services. At the heart of this transformation are smart contracts—self-executing contracts that facilitate, verify, and enforce the terms of an agreement [1].

arxiv-2508-09449.title: RASR: Retrieval-Augmented Super Resolution for Practical Reference-based Image Restoration
arxiv-2508-09449.creator: Jiaqi Yan 1,2∗ , Shuning Xu 2,3 , Xiangyu Chen 2† , Dell Zhang 2 , Jiantao Zhou 3 , Jie Tang 1 , Gangshan Wu 1 , Jie Liu 1†
arxiv-2508-09449.description: Abstract Reference-based Super Resolution (RefSR) improves upon Single Image Super Resolution (SISR) by leveraging high-quality reference images to enhance texture fidelity and visual realism. However, a critical limitation of existing RefSR approaches is their reliance on manually curated target-reference image pairs, which severely constrains their practicality in real-world scenarios.

pmc-10716139.title: Effects of accelerometer-based sedentary time and physical activity on DEXA-measured fat mass in 6059 children
pmc-10716139.creator: Andrew O Agbaje, Wei Perng, Tomi-Pekka Tuomainen
pmc-10716139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Globally, childhood obesity is on the rise and the effect of objectively measured movement behaviour on body composition remains unclear. Longitudinal and causal mediation relationships of accelerometer-based sedentary time (ST), light physical activity (LPA), and moderate-to-vigorous physical activity (MVPA) with dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry-measured fat mass were examined in 6059 children aged 11 years followed-up until age 24 years from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC), UK birth cohort.

pmc-11301862.description: BackgroundIO-based regimens (IO + IO or IO + VEGF inhibitor) represent current standard of care systemic therapies for the management of patients with mRCC. pmc-11439323.title: Mindfulness to enhance quality of life and support advance care planning: a pilot randomized controlled trial for adults with advanced cancer and their family caregivers
pmc-11439323.creator: Catherine E Mosher, Kathleen A Beck-Coon, Wei Wu, Ashley B Lewson, Patrick V Stutz, Linda F Brown, Qing Tang, Paul R Helft, Kristin Levoy, Susan E Hickman, Shelley A Johns
pmc-11439323.description: BackgroundPatients with advanced cancer and family caregivers often use avoidant coping strategies, such as delaying advance care planning discussions, which contribute to deterioration in their quality of life. Mindfulness-based interventions have shown promise in improving quality of life in this population but have rarely been applied to advance care planning.

pmc-12639010.description: As the use of wearable electrocardiogram (ECG) data for modeling purposes continues to rise, there is a pressing need for signal quality assessment (SQA) algorithms capable of identifying segments of signal from which reliable data can be obtained.
